5 Oxo hexahydoquinoline derivatives were synthesized as modulators of ABC transporters to overcome MDR.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and synthesis of 5 oxohexahydroquinolone derivatives bearing 2 pyridine carboxylic acid substituents at N3 and different aromatic substitutions at N4.
the development and characterization of new 5-oxo-hexahydroquinoline-3-carboxylates as inhibitors of the efflux pumps of the ATP-binding cassette family.
synthesis of novel 5 oxohexahydroquinoline (5 OHHQ) derivatives and their evaluation as modulators of ATP binding cassette transporters.
